text_block_list.text:
Maruzensky didn't seem to be feeling well,
so I decided to let her rest in the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I'll make sure to get plenty of rest and shake off this fatigue.
Bye-byeee♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Oh, where am I?
Where's the academy... and everyone else?

text_block_list.name: New Humanity A
text_block_list.text:
This is a world 120 million years in the future—
all relics of the past have perished in an ice age.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
No way... Trainer-kun and everyone else, and even the
Italian food, the bavarois, and the tiramisu too!?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
No way... Trainer-chan and everyone else, and even the
Italian food, the bavarois, and the tiramisu too!?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
S-Surely baby tees and nata de coco are still around, right?
I mean, they're cutting-edge, aren't they?

text_block_list.name: New Humanity B
text_block_list.text: No, you are the only one left.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
No way...!! How could this...
All alone in a place like this, what am I supposed to—
Don't worry, Maruzen-chan!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
That sound of screeching brakes—
Could it be Tacchan!?

text_block_list.name: Tacchan
text_block_list.text:
Even if that cool and hip culture fades away,
you're still right here.

text_block_list.name: Tacchan
text_block_list.text:
All you have to do is tell them once more.
I'm sure your Trainer wants that too!

text_block_list.name: Tacchan
text_block_list.text:
All you have to do is tell them once more.
I'm sure your Trainer wants that too!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Tac-chan, Trainer-kun... That's right.
Moping around won't do us any good, absolutely nothing!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Tac-chan, Trainer-chan... That's right.
Moping around won't do us any good, absolutely nothing!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Watch me, everyone... As the top youth of today,
I'll pass down the freshest, most fab things around!

text_block_list.name: New Humanity C
text_block_list.text: S-So this is the legendary disco! My body is catching the fever all on its own...!!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"Groovy, keep it up!
Now, let's play back that era...!!"

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Gasp!
...A dream?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
What a strange dream that was...
But I feel such a great sense of accomplishment♪

Thanks to getting some good rest,
Maruzensky seems to have recovered from her fatigue.

After that, Maruzensky established her totally rad
culture in the New World. But one day—

text_block_list.name: New Humanity C
text_block_list.text:
It's a mammoth!! At this rate,
both the disco and the resort club will be destroyed!!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Stop! No reckless gung-ho charging!
Halt-o-mammoth! ...Mammoth!!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Nooooo!!
I'm so ticked oooooff!!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Gasp!
...W-Was it... a dream?

Perhaps plagued by nightmares,
Maruzensky didn't seem to feel refreshed despite resting.
